item.title: 54 people treated and 19 taken to hospital after West Midlands fire, as thousands evacuated in Croatia – Europe live
item.summary: Fires also blaze in Germany and France as extreme heat continues to grip Europe today Four taken to hospital and homes damaged in West Midlands fires England has received just 4mm of rain so far in August, or 6% of the long-term average for the month , the Environment Agency said on Friday, as reported by PA. It follows the driest July on record for the country , when only 7mm of rain was measured, or 10% of the average. Continue reading...
